```{r}
## 1. Open and inspect the EMEP4UK 2024 file

library(terra)
library(ncdf4)
library(rstudioapi)

# Find the folder containing this R Markdown file
rmd_path <- getActiveDocumentContext()$path

if (!nzchar(rmd_path)) {
  stop(
    "Save and open EMEP4UK_SIA_analysis.Rmd before running this code."
  )
}

analysis_dir <- dirname(rmd_path)

# Location of the downloaded NetCDF file
emep_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "raw_data",
  "EMEP4UK_met2024_emis2023.nc"
)

if (!file.exists(emep_file)) {
  stop("EMEP4UK file not found:\n", emep_file)
}

cat(
  "File found:", basename(emep_file),
  "\nFile size:", round(file.info(emep_file)$size / 1e9, 2), "GB\n"
)

# Limit terra's memory use and create a temporary working folder
terra_temp <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "processed_data",
  "terra_temp"
)

dir.create(
  terra_temp,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

terraOptions(
  memfrac = 0.5,
  tempdir = terra_temp,
  progress = 1
)

# Read only the NetCDF header to identify available variables
nc <- nc_open(
  emep_file,
  readunlim = FALSE
)

available_variables <- names(nc$var)

nc_close(nc)
rm(nc)

# Variables relevant to the analysis
variables_needed <- c(
  "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",  # total PM2.5
  "SURF_ug_SIA",        # secondary inorganic aerosol
  "SURF_ug_NH4_F",      # particulate ammonium
  "SURF_ug_NO3_F",      # fine particulate nitrate
  "SURF_ug_SO4",        # particulate sulfate
  "SURF_ug_PPM25",      # primary PM2.5
  "SURF_ug_NH3",        # gaseous ammonia
  "HMIX",               # mixing-layer height
  "WDEP_PREC"            # precipitation
)

variable_check <- data.frame(
  variable = variables_needed,
  available = variables_needed %in% available_variables
)

print(variable_check, row.names = FALSE)

# Stop if the two essential variables are missing
essential_variables <- c(
  "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",
  "SURF_ug_SIA"
)

if (!all(essential_variables %in% available_variables)) {
  stop("An essential PM2.5 or SIA variable is missing.")
}

# Open only total PM2.5 and SIA
# The values remain stored in the NetCDF file, not loaded into RAM
pm25_2024 <- rast(
  emep_file,
  subds = "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50"
)

sia_2024 <- rast(
  emep_file,
  subds = "SURF_ug_SIA"
)

# Check the resulting objects
print(pm25_2024)
print(sia_2024)

cat(
  "\nNumber of daily SIA layers:", nlyr(sia_2024),
  "\nSpatial resolution:", paste(res(sia_2024), collapse = " × "),
  "\nValues currently held in RAM:", inMemory(sia_2024),
  "\n"
)

print(range(time(sia_2024)))

# Display the first daily SIA map
plot(
  sia_2024[[1]],
  main = "EMEP4UK secondary inorganic aerosol: first day"
)
```

```{r}
## 2. Select AURN background locations for PM2.5 validation

background_types <- c(
  "Urban Background",
  "Suburban Background",
  "Rural Background"
)

# Import complete AURN metadata
aurn_meta_2024 <- openair::importMeta(
  source = "aurn",
  all = TRUE,
  year = 2024
)

# Standardise column names
names(aurn_meta_2024) <- gsub("\\.", "_", names(aurn_meta_2024))

# Select background locations measuring PM2.5 during 2024
aurn_sites_2024 <- aurn_meta_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^PM2\\.5", variable, ignore.case = TRUE),
    site_type %in% background_types,
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Convert locations to the EMEP projection
aurn_points_2024 <- terra::vect(
  aurn_sites_2024,
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
) |>
  terra::project(terra::crs(sia_2024))

cat("Selected AURN locations:", nrow(aurn_sites_2024), "\n")
print(table(aurn_sites_2024$site_type))

# Plot modelled SIA with AURN validation locations
plot(
  sia_2024[[1]],
  main = paste(
    "EMEP4UK modelled SIA with selected",
    "AURN background monitoring locations",
    "1 January 2024",
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  plg = list(title = "SIA (ug/m3)")
)

plot(
  aurn_points_2024,
  add = TRUE,
  pch = 21,
  bg = "#E57200",
  col = "white",
  cex = 0.8
)
```

```{r}
## 3. Extract daily EMEP4UK values at AURN locations

pm25_at_aurn <- terra::extract(
  pm25_2024,
  aurn_points_2024,
  ID = FALSE
)

sia_at_aurn <- terra::extract(
  sia_2024,
  aurn_points_2024,
  ID = FALSE
)

aurn_emep_2024 <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  code = aurn_sites_2024$code,
  date = as.Date(terra::time(pm25_2024))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    emep_pm25_rh50 = as.vector(t(as.matrix(pm25_at_aurn))),
    emep_sia = as.vector(t(as.matrix(sia_at_aurn))),
    sia_percent_pm25 = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_pm25_rh50 > 0,
      100 * emep_sia / emep_pm25_rh50,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    aurn_sites_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        code,
        site,
        site_type,
        latitude,
        longitude
      ),
    by = "code"
  )

saveRDS(
  aurn_emep_2024,
  file.path(
    analysis_dir,
    "processed_data",
    "aurn_emep_2024.rds"
  )
)

cat(
  "Rows:", nrow(aurn_emep_2024),
  "\nSites:", dplyr::n_distinct(aurn_emep_2024$code),
  "\nDates:", paste(range(aurn_emep_2024$date), collapse = " to "),
  "\nMissing PM2.5:", sum(is.na(aurn_emep_2024$emep_pm25_rh50)),
  "\nMissing SIA:", sum(is.na(aurn_emep_2024$emep_sia)),
  "\n"
)
```
```{r}
## 4. Import measured AURN PM2.5 and calculate daily means

aurn_hourly_2024 <- openair::importAURN(
  site = aurn_sites_2024$code,
  year = 2024
) |>
  dplyr::select(
    code,
    site,
    date,
    `pm2.5`
  )

# Calculate annual hourly data capture for each site
aurn_capture_2024 <- aurn_hourly_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(code, site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    valid_hours = sum(!is.na(`pm2.5`)),
    capture_percent = 100 * valid_hours / (366 * 24),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

valid_aurn_sites_2024 <- aurn_capture_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(capture_percent >= 75)

# Calculate daily means requiring at least 75% hourly coverage
aurn_daily_2024 <- openair::timeAverage(
  aurn_hourly_2024,
  avg.time = "day",
  statistic = "mean",
  data.thresh = 75,
  type = c("site", "code"),
  interval = "hour"
) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    site,
    date = as.Date(date),
    aurn_pm25 = `pm2.5`
  ) |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    valid_aurn_sites_2024,
    by = c("code", "site")
  )

saveRDS(
  aurn_daily_2024,
  file.path(
    analysis_dir,
    "processed_data",
    "aurn_daily_pm25_2024.rds"
  )
)

cat(
  "Imported sites:", dplyr::n_distinct(aurn_hourly_2024$code),
  "\nSites with at least 75% annual capture:",
  nrow(valid_aurn_sites_2024),
  "\nDaily records:", nrow(aurn_daily_2024),
  "\nDate range:",
  paste(range(aurn_daily_2024$date), collapse = " to "),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
## 5. Match AURN observations with EMEP4UK and calculate annual means

duplicate_aurn_keys <- sum(
  duplicated(aurn_daily_2024[c("code", "date")])
)

duplicate_emep_keys <- sum(
  duplicated(aurn_emep_2024[c("code", "date")])
)

if (duplicate_aurn_keys > 0 || duplicate_emep_keys > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate site-date keys detected before joining.")
}

# Join measured and modelled daily concentrations
aurn_emep_matched_all_2024 <- aurn_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    aurn_emep_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        code,
        date,
        emep_pm25_rh50,
        emep_sia
      ),
    by = c("code", "date")
  )

unmatched_model_rows <- sum(
  is.na(aurn_emep_matched_all_2024$emep_pm25_rh50)
)

# Retain complete measured-modelled daily pairs
aurn_emep_matched_2024 <- aurn_emep_matched_all_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(aurn_pm25),
    !is.na(emep_pm25_rh50),
    !is.na(emep_sia)
  )

# Calculate annual means at each AURN location
aurn_emep_annual_all_2024 <- aurn_emep_matched_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(code, site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    matched_days = dplyr::n(),
    paired_capture_percent = 100 * matched_days / 366,
    aurn_pm25_annual = mean(aurn_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    emep_pm25_annual = mean(emep_pm25_rh50, na.rm = TRUE),
    emep_sia_annual = mean(emep_sia, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sia_percent_annual =
      100 * emep_sia_annual / emep_pm25_annual
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    aurn_sites_2024 |>
      dplyr::select(
        code,
        site_type,
        latitude,
        longitude
      ),
    by = "code"
  )

# Require at least 75% paired daily coverage
aurn_emep_annual_2024 <- aurn_emep_annual_all_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(paired_capture_percent >= 75)

# Evaluate annual EMEP PM2.5 against measured AURN PM2.5
annual_validation_stats_2024 <- openair::modStats(
  aurn_emep_annual_2024,
  obs = "aurn_pm25_annual",
  mod = "emep_pm25_annual"
)

validation_output_2024 <- list(
  daily_matched = aurn_emep_matched_2024,
  annual_site_means = aurn_emep_annual_2024,
  model_statistics = annual_validation_stats_2024
)

saveRDS(
  validation_output_2024,
  file.path(
    analysis_dir,
    "processed_data",
    "aurn_emep_validation_2024.rds"
  )
)

cat(
  "Duplicate AURN keys:", duplicate_aurn_keys,
  "\nDuplicate EMEP keys:", duplicate_emep_keys,
  "\nAURN records without an EMEP match:", unmatched_model_rows,
  "\nComplete matched site-days:", nrow(aurn_emep_matched_2024),
  "\nSites retained:", nrow(aurn_emep_annual_2024),
  "\nMatched-day range:",
  paste(range(aurn_emep_annual_2024$matched_days), collapse = " to "),
  "\n"
)

print(annual_validation_stats_2024)
```

```{r}
## 6. Plot annual EMEP4UK validation against AURN observations

annual_validation_plot_2024 <- openair::scatterPlot(
  aurn_emep_annual_2024,

  y = "emep_pm25_annual",

annual_validation_plot_2024
```

```{r}
## 7. Extract annual EMEP4UK concentrations at SAMHE schools

# Load the school metadata only if it is not already available
if (!exists("df_school_chars")) {
  
  project_dir <- dirname(dirname(analysis_dir))
  
  core_files <- c(
    file.path(project_dir, "analysis_core_objects.RData"),
    file.path(
      project_dir,
      "SAMHE_core_files",
      "analysis_core_objects.RData"
    )
  )
  
  core_files <- core_files[file.exists(core_files)]
  
  if (length(core_files) == 0) {
    stop("analysis_core_objects.RData could not be found.")
  }
  
  core_environment <- new.env()
  load(core_files[1], envir = core_environment)
  df_school_chars <- core_environment$df_school_chars
  
  rm(core_environment)
  gc()
}

# Create one valid coordinate pair per school
school_locations_2024 <- df_school_chars |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short),
    latitude = as.numeric(SchoolLatitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(SchoolLongitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(SchoolId_short),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

# Stop if a school has conflicting coordinates
if (anyDuplicated(school_locations_2024$SchoolId_short)) {
  stop("Some schools have more than one coordinate pair.")
}

# Convert school locations to the EMEP4UK coordinate system
school_points_2024 <- terra::vect(
  school_locations_2024,
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
) |>
  terra::project(terra::crs(pm25_2024))

# Location of the EMEP4UK NetCDF file
nc_file <- file.path(
  analysis_dir,
  "raw_data",
  "EMEP4UK_met2024_emis2023.nc"
)

if (!file.exists(nc_file)) {
  stop("EMEP4UK NetCDF file could not be found.")
}
# EMEP4UK variables to extract
emep_variables <- c(
  emep_pm25_annual = "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",
  emep_sia_annual  = "SURF_ug_SIA",
  emep_nh3_annual  = "SURF_ug_NH3",
  emep_nh4_annual  = "SURF_ug_NH4_F",
  emep_no3_annual  = "SURF_ug_NO3_F",
  emep_so4_annual  = "SURF_ug_SO4"
)

# Extract the 366 daily values and calculate each annual mean
extract_annual_mean <- function(variable) {
  
  message("Extracting ", variable)
  
  raster <- terra::rast(
    nc_file,
    subds = variable
  )
  
  daily_values <- terra::extract(
    raster,
    school_points_2024,
    ID = FALSE,
    method = "simple"
  )
  
  annual_mean <- rowMeans(
    as.matrix(daily_values),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  annual_mean[is.nan(annual_mean)] <- NA_real_
  annual_mean
}

annual_values_2024 <- lapply(
  emep_variables,
  extract_annual_mean
)

# Combine school locations and annual concentrations
school_emep_annual_2024 <- dplyr::bind_cols(
  school_locations_2024,
  tibble::as_tibble(annual_values_2024)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sia_percent_pm25_annual = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_pm25_annual > 0,
      100 * emep_sia_annual / emep_pm25_annual,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

saveRDS(
  school_emep_annual_2024,
  file.path(
    analysis_dir,
    "processed_data",
    "school_emep_annual_2024.rds"
  )
)

cat(
  "Schools extracted:", nrow(school_emep_annual_2024),
  "\nSchools with missing EMEP values:",
  sum(!complete.cases(school_emep_annual_2024)),
  "\nAnnual SIA percentage range:",
  paste(
    round(
      range(
        school_emep_annual_2024$sia_percent_pm25_annual,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      1
    ),
    collapse = " to "
  ),
  "%\n"
)
```
```{r}
## Replace the recent SAMHE processing with the original method

project_dir <- dirname(dirname(analysis_dir))

core_files <- c(
  file.path(project_dir, "analysis_core_objects.RData"),
  file.path(
    project_dir,
    "SAMHE_core_files",
    "analysis_core_objects.RData"
  )
)

core_files <- core_files[file.exists(core_files)]

core_environment <- new.env()
load(core_files[1], envir = core_environment)

datetime_tz <- attr(
  core_environment$In_Out_24$DateTime,
  "tzone"
)

if (is.null(datetime_tz) || datetime_tz == "") {
  datetime_tz <- "UTC"
}

start_2024 <- as.POSIXct(
  "2024-01-01 00:00:00",
  tz = datetime_tz
)

end_2024 <- as.POSIXct(
  "2025-01-01 00:00:00",
  tz = datetime_tz
)

# Only select 2024; apply no additional exclusions
In_Out_24_2024 <- core_environment$In_Out_24[
  core_environment$In_Out_24$DateTime >= start_2024 &
    core_environment$In_Out_24$DateTime < end_2024,
  c(
    "SchoolId_short",
    "DateTime",
    "pm02",
    "pm2.5"
  )
]

rm(core_environment)
gc()

# Original school-level summarisation method
samhe_annual_2024 <- In_Out_24_2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    indoor_pm25_mean = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25_mean = mean(`pm2.5`, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_observations = dplyr::n(),
    n_days = dplyr::n_distinct(as.Date(DateTime)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Left join preserves every SAMHE school
samhe_emep_2024 <- samhe_annual_2024 |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    school_emep_annual_2024 |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short)
      ),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  )

saveRDS(
  samhe_emep_2024,
  file.path(
    analysis_dir,
    "processed_data",
    "samhe_emep_2024.rds"
  )
)

cat(
  "SAMHE schools:", nrow(samhe_annual_2024),
  "\nSchools matched to EMEP4UK:",
  sum(!is.na(samhe_emep_2024$emep_sia_annual)),
  "\nSchools without EMEP4UK:",
  sum(is.na(samhe_emep_2024$emep_sia_annual)),
  "\nObserved-day range:",
  paste(range(samhe_annual_2024$n_days), collapse = " to "),
  "\n"
)
```
```{r}

## 9. Prepare daily SAMHE and EMEP4UK fine-SIA data

analysis_school_locations_2024 <- school_locations_2024 |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    samhe_annual_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  )

analysis_school_points_2024 <- terra::vect(
  analysis_school_locations_2024,
  geom = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
) |>
  terra::project(terra::crs(pm25_2024))

mean_available <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Preserve the original SAMHE data and exclusions
samhe_daily_2024 <- In_Out_24_2024 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SchoolId_short = as.character(SchoolId_short),
    date = as.Date(DateTime)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short, date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean_available(pm02),
    aurn_pm25 = mean_available(`pm2.5`),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daily_variables_2024 <- c(
  emep_pm25 = "SURF_ug_PM25_rh50",
  emep_sia_total = "SURF_ug_SIA",
  emep_nh4 = "SURF_ug_NH4_F",
  emep_no3_f = "SURF_ug_NO3_F",
  emep_no3_c = "SURF_ug_NO3_C",
  emep_so4 = "SURF_ug_SO4"
)

if (!all(daily_variables_2024 %in% available_variables)) {
  stop("One or more required EMEP4UK variables are missing.")
}

model_dates_2024 <- as.Date(terra::time(pm25_2024))

extract_daily_variable <- function(variable) {

  message("Extracting ", variable)

  raster <- terra::rast(
    emep_file,
    subds = variable
  )

  if (!identical(
    as.Date(terra::time(raster)),
    model_dates_2024
  )) {
    stop("The EMEP4UK dates do not match for ", variable)
  }

  values <- terra::extract(
    raster,
    analysis_school_points_2024,
    ID = FALSE
  )

  as.vector(t(as.matrix(values)))
}

daily_values_2024 <- lapply(
  daily_variables_2024,
  extract_daily_variable
)

school_emep_daily_2024 <- dplyr::bind_cols(
  tidyr::expand_grid(
    SchoolId_short =
      analysis_school_locations_2024$SchoolId_short,
    date = model_dates_2024
  ),
  tibble::as_tibble(daily_values_2024)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Fine SIA associated with ammonium salts
    fine_sia =
      emep_nh4 +
      emep_no3_f +
      emep_so4,

    # EMEP4UK total SIA also contains coarse nitrate
    reconstructed_total_sia =
      fine_sia +
      emep_no3_c,

    total_sia_closure = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_sia_total > 0,
      100 * reconstructed_total_sia / emep_sia_total,
      NA_real_
    ),

    fine_sia_percent_pm25 = dplyr::if_else(
      emep_pm25 > 0,
      100 * fine_sia / emep_pm25,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

rm(daily_values_2024)
gc()

daily_fine_sia_2024 <- samhe_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    school_emep_daily_2024,
    by = c("SchoolId_short", "date")
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(indoor_pm25),
    is.finite(aurn_pm25),
    is.finite(emep_pm25),
    is.finite(fine_sia)
  )

school_coverage_2024 <- daily_fine_sia_2024 |>
  dplyr::count(
    SchoolId_short,
    name = "complete_days"
  )

cat(
  "Complete school-days:", nrow(daily_fine_sia_2024),
  "\nSchools:",
  dplyr::n_distinct(
    daily_fine_sia_2024$SchoolId_short
  ),
  "\nDuplicate school-dates:",
  sum(duplicated(
    daily_fine_sia_2024[
      c("SchoolId_short", "date")
    ]
  )),
  "\nSchools with at least 90 complete days:",
  sum(school_coverage_2024$complete_days >= 90),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
## 10. Calculate annual fine-SIA composition and relationships

# Calculate EMEP4UK means using all 366 model days
model_annual_fine_sia_2024 <- school_emep_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    emep_pm25_annual =
      mean(emep_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),

    fine_sia_annual =
      mean(fine_sia, na.rm = TRUE),

    nitrate_annual =
      mean(emep_no3_f, na.rm = TRUE),

    sulfate_annual =
      mean(emep_so4, na.rm = TRUE),

    ammonium_annual =
      mean(emep_nh4, na.rm = TRUE),

    nitrate_dominant_days =
      100 * mean(
        emep_no3_f > emep_so4,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    total_sia_closure =
      100 *
      mean(
        reconstructed_total_sia,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) /
      mean(
        emep_sia_total,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fine_sia_percent_pm25 =
      100 *
      fine_sia_annual /
      emep_pm25_annual,

    nitrate_share =
      100 *
      nitrate_annual /
      fine_sia_annual,

    sulfate_share =
      100 *
      sulfate_annual /
      fine_sia_annual,

    ammonium_share =
      100 *
      ammonium_annual /
      fine_sia_annual
  )

annual_fine_sia_school_2024 <- samhe_annual_2024 |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    SchoolId_short =
      as.character(SchoolId_short),

    indoor_pm25_mean,
    outdoor_pm25_mean,

    observed_days = n_days
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    model_annual_fine_sia_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    school_coverage_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    school_locations_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  )

# Primary analysis using at least 90 complete days
annual_fine_sia_analysis_2024 <-
  annual_fine_sia_school_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    complete_days >= 90,
    is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
    is.finite(fine_sia_annual)
  )

fine_sia_annual_summary_2024 <-
  annual_fine_sia_analysis_2024 |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    schools = dplyr::n(),

    median_fine_sia_percent_pm25 =
      median(fine_sia_percent_pm25),

    median_nitrate_share =
      median(nitrate_share),

    median_sulfate_share =
      median(sulfate_share),

    median_ammonium_share =
      median(ammonium_share),

    median_nitrate_dominant_days =
      median(nitrate_dominant_days),

    median_total_sia_closure =
      median(total_sia_closure)
  )

print(fine_sia_annual_summary_2024)

# Coverage sensitivity analysis
annual_fine_sia_sensitivity_2024 <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c(1, 30, 90),
    function(minimum_days) {

      results <- annual_fine_sia_school_2024 |>
        dplyr::filter(
          complete_days >= minimum_days,
          is.finite(indoor_pm25_mean),
          is.finite(fine_sia_annual)
        )

      pearson <- stats::cor.test(
        results$fine_sia_annual,
        results$indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "pearson"
      )

      spearman <- stats::cor.test(
        results$fine_sia_annual,
        results$indoor_pm25_mean,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        minimum_days = minimum_days,
        schools = nrow(results),

        pearson_r =
          unname(pearson$estimate),

        r_squared =
          unname(pearson$estimate)^2,

        pearson_p =
          pearson$p.value,

        spearman_rho =
          unname(spearman$estimate),

        spearman_p =
          spearman$p.value
      )
    }
  )

print(annual_fine_sia_sensitivity_2024)

fine_sia_annual_plot_2024 <-
  openair::scatterPlot(
    annual_fine_sia_analysis_2024,
    x = "fine_sia_annual",
    y = "indoor_pm25_mean",
    z = "complete_days",
    linear = TRUE,
    ci = TRUE,
    cols = "viridis",
    key.title = "Complete days",
    auto.text = FALSE,

    xlab =
      "EMEP4UK annual mean fine SIA (µg/m³)",

    ylab =
      "SAMHE 2024 mean indoor PM2.5 (µg/m³)",

    title =
      "Annual fine SIA and indoor PM2.5 at SAMHE schools",

    subtitle =
      "Schools with at least 90 complete matched days in 2024"
  )

```

```{r}
## 11. Compare high fine-SIA days with other observed days

fine_episode_daily_2024 <- daily_fine_sia_2024 |>
  dplyr::select(
    SchoolId_short,
    date,
    fine_sia,
    aurn_pm25,
    indoor_pm25
  )

# Define high days separately for each school
fine_episode_school_2024 <-
  fine_episode_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::group_by(SchoolId_short) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_days = dplyr::n(),

    high_fine_sia =
      fine_sia >=
      stats::quantile(
        fine_sia,
        0.90
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_days =
      dplyr::first(n_days),

    fine_sia_change =
      mean(fine_sia[high_fine_sia]) -
      mean(fine_sia[!high_fine_sia]),

    aurn_change =
      mean(aurn_pm25[high_fine_sia]) -
      mean(aurn_pm25[!high_fine_sia]),

    indoor_change =
      mean(indoor_pm25[high_fine_sia]) -
      mean(indoor_pm25[!high_fine_sia]),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

episode_sensitivity_fine_2024 <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c(2, 30, 90),
    function(minimum_days) {

      results <- fine_episode_school_2024 |>
        dplyr::filter(
          n_days >= minimum_days
        )

      tibble::tibble(
        minimum_days = minimum_days,
        schools = nrow(results),

        median_fine_sia_change =
          median(results$fine_sia_change),

        median_aurn_change =
          median(results$aurn_change),

        median_indoor_change =
          median(results$indoor_change),

        schools_indoor_higher_percent =
          100 *
          mean(results$indoor_change > 0),

        wilcoxon_p =
          stats::wilcox.test(
            results$indoor_change,
            mu = 0,
            exact = FALSE
          )$p.value
      )
    }
  )

print(episode_sensitivity_fine_2024)
```

```{r}
## 15. Daily 2024 fine-SIA episode time series

eligible_schools_2024 <- school_coverage_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(complete_days >= 90) |>
  dplyr::select(SchoolId_short)

# Modelled fine SIA uses the same fixed set of 262 schools every day
daily_model_series_2024 <- school_emep_daily_2024 |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    eligible_schools_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    fine_sia = mean(fine_sia, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Indoor and AURN means give each available school equal weight
daily_observed_series_2024 <- daily_fine_sia_2024 |>
  dplyr::semi_join(
    eligible_schools_2024,
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    aurn_pm25 = mean(aurn_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    indoor_pm25 = mean(indoor_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    schools_reporting = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daily_episode_series_2024 <- daily_model_series_2024 |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    daily_observed_series_2024,
    by = "date"
  )

# Identify the highest 10% of national mean fine-SIA days
episode_threshold_2024 <- stats::quantile(
  daily_episode_series_2024$fine_sia,
  0.90,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

candidate_fine_sia_episodes_2024 <-
  daily_episode_series_2024 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    fine_sia >= episode_threshold_2024
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(fine_sia)
  )

cat(
  "Fine-SIA episode threshold:",
  round(episode_threshold_2024, 2),
  "µg/m³",
  "\nEpisode days:",
  nrow(candidate_fine_sia_episodes_2024),
  "\n"
)

print(
  candidate_fine_sia_episodes_2024,
  n = 15
)

daily_episode_timeplot_2024 <- openair::timePlot(
  daily_episode_series_2024,
  pollutant = c(
    "fine_sia",
    "aurn_pm25",
    "indoor_pm25"
  ),
  group = TRUE,
  cols = c(
    "#2A9D8F",
    "#E57200",
    "#7A1FA2"
  ),
  name.pol = c(
    "EMEP4UK modelled fine SIA",
    "School-paired AURN PM2.5",
    "SAMHE indoor PM2.5"
  ),
  auto.text = FALSE,
  date.breaks = 12,
  date.format = "%b",
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = "Daily mean concentration (µg/m³)",
  title = "Daily fine SIA, outdoor and indoor PM2.5 during 2024",
  subtitle = paste(
    "262 schools with at least 90 complete matched days;",
    "daily observed means use available schools"
  ),
  key.position = "bottom",
  plot = FALSE
)

plot(daily_episode_timeplot_2024)
```
